text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick ask for the launch week assets — can runtime run a compact benchmark we can cite in the webinar deck and blog? Need numbers and a reproducible artifact. :sparkles:
Ethan (Product Marketing): Metrics we need: p10/p50/p90 latencies, tokens/sec, and an estimated $/5k tokens for each configuration. Also a tiny example transcript (one code completion and one chat) we can show on a slide.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Can do. What's the target models and what do you mean by "configuration"?
Maya (Marketing): Configs = model + precision (fp16, int8, q4_0) + any runtime flags (kv_cache/sharding). Primary models: redwood-open-1.2 and a single-community-70b (if quantized variant is feasible). Prefer 3 variants total.
Tess (eng-ml): For quality checks, we'll run a 30-sample micro-eval for code correctness and a 30-sample semantic check for chat. If a quantized variant shows >7% drop in our quality metric, note it in the brief.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Proposal: 5-minute steady-state run, simulated 40 concurrent users, request mix 60% code (avg input len 180 tokens), 40% chat (avg input len 90). Batch size baseline 6, max_new_tokens 128, kv_cache enabled. We'll record p10/p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, per-request tail latencies, and aggregate token counts for cost calc.
Maya (Marketing): Sounds good. Also: provide both a raw CSV and a marketing-ready CSV (no prompt text; include prompt length, response length, model/variant, latency metrics). We want PNG-ready charts.
Ethan (Product Marketing): One more: can you give a 1-sentence plain-English caveat for the blog about synthetic workload vs real traffic?
Ravi (eng-runtime): Sure. We'll add: "Benchmarks run on synthetic, controlled workloads; real-world latency and cost depend on prompt shape and concurrency patterns."
Tess (eng-ml): For the micro-eval, we'll include small unit tests for code (run compile where safe) and a 3-annotator majority label for chat quality. We'll flag any inconsistencies.
Maya (Marketing): Can you include example payloads and curl commands we can paste into the press kit?
Ravi (eng-runtime): Yep. Example payloads we'll include: 1) code short, 2) code long, 3) two-turn chat. Repro snippet: ```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-1.2","input":"// sort array\nfunction sort(arr){","max_tokens":64,"temperature":0.1}'```
Ethan (Product Marketing): For the cost calc, use the internal accounting rate card and show the formula in the README (tokens * unit_rate / 5000).
Ravi (eng-runtime): We'll include the exact runtime flags (kernel version, cudnn/kernel build ids, quant backend flags) in the README for reproducibility. If the community-70b can't be run with int8 on shard, we'll substitute a 33b variant and note it.
bench-bot: job queued (id jb-9901). Expected runtime: ~4 hours to finish micro-evals and smoke runs.
bench-bot: jb-9901 -> running on bench-cluster-2 (logs: https://internal-bench/jobs/jb-9901/logs).
Maya (Marketing): Can you aim to drop sanitized CSV + one-slide-ready KPI table in #marketing in the morning? Need time to build visuals.
Ravi (eng-runtime): We'll try. If runs are stable we'll have sanitized artifacts by 10:00 PT tomorrow. If we hit >12% variance between runs, we'll escalate and run a 30-minute stability profile and include confidence intervals.
Tess (eng-ml): Note on quality diff: we'll attach a short diff summary (examples where q4_0 changed token choices) so marketing can call out tradeoffs.
Ethan (Product Marketing): Also include a short bullet list of recommended messaging: e.g., "Comparable throughput with q4_0 at ~X% lower cost; slight accuracy tradeoffs observed on complex code tasks."
Ravi (eng-runtime): Will provide. Also exporting reproduction scripts (python + curl), and a sanitized sample transcript file for the slide.
bench-bot: jb-9901 status: completed. Summary: 40 concurrent, 5m smoke + micro-evals. Results: https://internal-bench/jobs/jb-9901/results.zip
Maya (Marketing): Amazing — please drop the sanitized CSV and the KPI table now and tag us. Thanks team!! :rocket:
